## ip/proxy/cache/reset-counters-all 
**Type:** Command

Resets the `hits` counter of all rules in [`/ip/proxy/cache`](/docs/cli-reference/ip/proxy/cache/). For an overview, see [Web Proxy](/docs/network-management/proxy/web-proxy).
